subject: Vendr onboarding: ownership mapping, evidence Q&A, and walkthrough
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@vendr.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr onboarding: ownership mapping + quick QA

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this — I'm the onboarding lead at Vendr. We're starting your portal profile for "Redwood Inference" and I need two quick confirmations so we can finish the initial mapping:

1) Who should be marked as the primary profile owner in Vendr (name + email)?
2) What scope are you planning to surface first (SIG, CAIQ, SOC 2 evidence)? Any immediate attachments we should expect?

If useful, I can run a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow to show uploader flows and delegated uploader options. I've attached a short checklist for the process.

Attachments: vendr_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Cheers,
Samantha Lee
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
S: +1 415-555-0199
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T13:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: ownership mapping + quick QA

Thanks Samantha — looping Ben (sec ops) here.

Primary owner for the Vendr profile: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> (Security Program Manager). Ben Carter will act as the technical evidence steward.

Scope: we'll start with SIG Lite (questions) and SOC 2 attachments (report + system description) and then add CAIQ where the customer requests it. Expect the following upload items in the first wave:
- SOC2 report (pdf)
- System description (pdf)
- s3-presign-policy (pdf) for proof-of-possession of logs/archives

Ben — any additional notes on upload method? Samantha, a walkthrough tomorrow at 10:30 PT works for us. If you'd prefer later, Ben can host an ops-specific session for uploader auth.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <sam.lee@vendr.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T15:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: ownership mapping + quick QA

Hi Samantha — quick technical notes from SecOps: 

1) Preferred evidence uploads: we prefer to push signed artifacts into the Vendr evidence sink when available (PDFs). For automated artifacts (logs, manifests) we'll use a short-lived presign flow that uploads to a named bucket and then the presigned URL is registered in Vendr.

2) Delegated uploader: we will need either a Vendr service-account + API key (recommended) or an SSO invite flow for our delegated uploader. Which option is supported for enterprise accounts?

3) Filenames we'll upload initially: s3-presign-policy.pdf, SOC2-Redwood-2026.pdf, system-description-2026.pdf.

Inline original for context:
> On Mon, Sep 14, 2026 at 10:12 AM Samantha Lee <sam.lee@vendr.com> wrote:
> > Thanks for taking this — I'm the onboarding lead at Vendr...

If Vendr supports service accounts, Ben can hook up the automation this week. Thanks.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security Operations Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@vendr.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: ownership mapping + quick QA

Perfect — we support both flows.

Plan: 
1) I've provisioned a temporary service account for Redwood with API key scoping limited to evidence uploads. We'll send the key via our secure token channel after your admin confirms.
2) Portal link: https://app.vendr.com/portal/redwood-inference — that will be live for owners once the owner mapping is accepted.
3) Walkthrough confirmed: 2026-09-15 10:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

I also uploaded a quick instructions PDF for the service-account uploader and the presign pattern. See attachment.

Attachments: vendr_uploader_instructions.pdf (PDF)
Related: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

See you on the walkthrough. If you want the API key now to try automation, Ben, I can share it via the secure channel after a short attestation from your admin.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>
